cases.name: depth-positive
cases.tradeoff: L3 requires a resolved NestInterceptor implementation with intercept plus attributed RxJS catchError and finalize calls in the same class; controllers and providers split across classes are not combined.

cases.name: one-required-signal-missing
cases.tradeoff: One required high-precision signal is absent; the depth rule must fail closed.

cases.name: signals-split-across-classes
cases.tradeoff: RxJS error and cleanup operators in another class cannot complete a Nest interceptor implementation.
